title: Authentication module onboarding: login errors
task_summary: Help a new developer update login error handling in the authentication module

module_overview.text: The login route checks credentials and returns a signed session token on success.

relevant_files.responsibility: Defines the HTTP login handler and its 401 response
Verifies passwords and creates session tokens
relevant_files.task_relevance: Check the failure result before changing error handling
Confirm the current login response shape

relevant_files.responsibility: Looks up demo users from an in-memory table
relevant_files.task_relevance: Understand where the credential check gets its record
Extend coverage for the desired error behavior
Use these commands to run the demo

flow.text: POST /login receives a LoginRequest and passes its username and password to authenticate.
authenticate looks up the user, compares the supplied password hash, and returns None on failure.
The route raises HTTP 401 for None and otherwise returns a LoginResponse with a session token.

api_dependencies.text: The handler is registered as POST /login with LoginResponse as its response model.
LoginRequest requires username and password; LoginResponse includes access_token and bearer token_type.

database_relationships.text: The demo stores users in a Python dictionary and get_user performs a username lookup.

conventions.text: Authentication failures return None from authenticate and become HTTP 401 in the route.
Session signing reads SESSION_SECRET from the environment.

local_setup.text: Create a Python 3.11 environment and install requirements with pip.
Set SESSION_SECRET, run uvicorn app.routes:app --reload, then run pytest.

first_steps.text: Inspect the route 401 response and the None branch in authenticate before editing the error behavior.
Extend the existing authentication tests for the chosen behavior.

unknowns: The selected files do not describe the desired replacement error wording or whether the response shape may change. Confirm those requirements with the task owner.
